title: Two Families of $q$-Supercongruences from Watson's Transformation
summary: In this paper, we establish two families of $q$-supercongruences modulo the third and fourth powers of a cyclotomic polynomial by employing Watson's ${}_{8}φ_7$ transformation, the creative microscoping method introduced by Guo and Zudilin, and the Chinese remainder theorem for coprime polynomials.
